name: TheDevToolsDir

sources.title: TheDevToolsDir submit form — 4-step flow with badge verification
TheDevToolsDir homepage — curated developer tools directory

conditions: Free plan requires embedding their dofollow badge HTML on your site and passing the in-form 'Verify Badge' check
requirements: Developer-tool products — categories are dev-infra-specific (CI/CD, Observability, Databases, APIs, Auth, Testing, Containers, etc.)
No account needed — the form is anonymous and asks only for an email 'for listing updates only'
preparation: Product URL (form has an auto-fill step that scrapes details)
Product name, tagline, description, screenshot, tags (comma-separated)
An email address for listing updates
Badge snippet deployed on the site — must be rel="dofollow": — the snippet updates with your product URL after submission
workflow: Open https://thedevtoolsdir.com/submit/ (?tier=free preselects the free plan)
Step 1: enter the product URL and run auto-fill
Step 2: confirm name/tagline/description, screenshot, ≤3 categories, tags, email
Step 3: choose Free / Paid $19 / Multiple Listings $29
Step 4 (free only): embed the badge and click 'Verify Badge', then Submit Product
watchFor: Honeypot field at the top — 'Leave this field empty'; filling it likely fails the submission
Badge verification happens INSIDE the form — the badge must be deployed before you finish submitting
The badge link must be dofollow (explicit rel="dofollow") — a nofollow badge won't verify
Multiple Listings ($29) cross-posts to sister directory TheSaaSDir for one price; Paid ($19) gives 3 dofollow links + featured, no badge
countsAsLive: A public product page at thedevtoolsdir.com/product/<slug>/ listed under its chosen categories.
unknowns: Whether free-tier outbound links are dofollow immediately or only after badge verification
Whether paid plans also undergo review before going live
